The '''Carrot''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[crops|crop]] that grows from [[Carrot Seeds]] after 3 days. It can be fed to a [[Horse]] to increase its {{Name|Speed|+0.4|class=inline}} for the rest of the day.<ref name="feedhorse" />

==Bundles==
Carrot may be chosen as one of the options for the {{Bundle|Spring Crops remixed||y}}.

==Recipes==
Carrot is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Carrot can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a dyeable [[File:Shirt159.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt And Belt]]. It can also be used as an orange [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the orange dye pot located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Carrot is not used in any [[quests]].
